controls.name: Stripe webhook signature check (sub-account)
controls.description: /consume-webhooks verifies the stripe-signature header against the raw body (constructEventFromPayload) before fanning the event out to Pub/Sub.
controls.weakness: The sibling /consume-agency-webhooks route, which carries wallet-recharge PaymentIntents, accepts the body without a signature check (line 35).

controls.name: Recharge webhook metadata and status gate
controls.description: handleAgencyWebhook only acts on payment_intent.succeeded with PI status 'succeeded', a positive finite metadata amount and matching companyId/entityId (or walletId for auto recharge); otherwise INVALID_METADATA.
controls.weakness: The credited amount is metadata.amount; it is never compared with paymentIntent.amount_received, so a $10 charge is not proven to credit exactly $10.

controls.name: One wallet credit per PaymentIntent
controls.description: The webhook path and the credit writer both look up an existing Stripe_Payment wallet txn with chargeId = PaymentIntent id, so a redelivered event is acked without a second credit.
controls.weakness: Agency/location wallets rely on read-then-write under a Redis lock; no unique Mongo index on chargeId is declared.

controls.name: walletRechargeLocks single-flight lock
controls.description: A unique (entityId, entityType) document with a 15-minute TTL stops concurrent auto-recharges and makes webhook credits nack-and-retry while a recharge is in flight.
controls.weakness: Agency PaymentIntent creation sends no Stripe idempotency key, so a lock that lapses mid-flight could allow a second charge.

controls.name: Positive-amount guard and wallet lock on credit
controls.description: createTransactionForRecharge rejects credits of 0 or less (FALSE_CREDIT), locks the wallet in Redis and writes the credit inside a Mongo session transaction.

controls.name: rechargefailurelogs failure trail
controls.description: Failed manual, auto and ACH recharges are logged with gateway and decline codes and feed the recharge-failure dashboards.
controls.weakness: Records failures only; a succeeded Stripe charge that never reaches the wallet leaves no row.

controls.name: Bill API eventId idempotency
controls.description: The billing controller rejects an eventId already in chargeV5 with 422 ALREADY_PROCESSED; the charge worker re-checks and treats Mongo 11000 as already processed.
controls.weakness: No unique index on chargeV5.eventId is declared in code, so the 11000 path depends on an index created outside the repo.

controls.name: Funds and wallet-active check before charge
controls.description: checkFunds/checkFundsV2 return FUND_CHECK_FAILED for a missing or INACTIVE wallet, or one with no complimentary credits and a negative balance.
controls.weakness: The rule is balance >= 0, not balance >= charge, so any single charge can take the wallet negative by design.

controls.name: Gatekeeper reservation, dedupe and true-up
controls.description: Usage is reserved in Redis before work runs (unique eventId/chargeId), trued up against the billed amount at settle, and 5xx Bill API failures are parked for a retry sweep.
controls.weakness: Evaluate and reserve are not atomic, so concurrent requests can overshoot a hard limit or free allowance.

controls.name: Charge and wallet debit in one transaction
controls.description: The PENDING wallet debit and the chargeV5 document are written in one Mongo session, so neither exists without the other.

controls.name: BaaS / rebilling config change log
controls.description: BaaS billing-config changes append to a per-entity logs array in baaslogs; rebillingconfigs records lastUpdatedBy.
controls.weakness: The log array is schemaless, with no enforced actor or reason fields.

controls.name: Provider cost captured on charge
controls.description: Producers may send cost on the bill request; it is stored on chargeV5.cost and forwarded as vendorCost on the GL transfer (used for Twilio margin).
controls.weakness: Optional and producer-supplied; not reconciled to provider invoices, and no Meta/WhatsApp or Mailgun cost fields were found.

controls.name: SMS rebill back-billing job
controls.description: A script reads SMSRebillAuditLogs, checks blade for an existing charge per message, and bills only unbilled ones (dry-run by default).

controls.name: Wallet lock during pending settlement
controls.description: Pending txns settle under a 600-second Redis wallet lock inside a DB transaction, stamping prevWalletBalance/walletBalance on each txn.

controls.name: Daily pending-settlement sweep
controls.description: Crons at 01:30 UTC (company) and 02:30 UTC (location) re-dispatch every wallet with PENDING txns, catching missed event-driven settlements.
controls.weakness: Re-settles silently; it does not report or alert on how many txns were stale.

controls.name: Refund cap and wallet lock
controls.description: Wallet refunds are capped at currentBalance minus rechargeThresholdBalance and processed under a Redis wallet lock that fails safe.

controls.name: Support credit/debit authorization and audit
controls.description: Support credits are allowed only from the support-portal workload, need a ticketNo deduped per ticket+entity, and are logged with performedBy, amount and product.
controls.weakness: No amount limit or second approver; performedBy can fall back to 'support_portal', and temp-refund-script credits wallets without this guard.

controls.name: TigerBeetle double entry with idempotent ids
controls.description: Ledger events post as linked debit/credit chains; UW and GL transfer ids derive from the Mongo chargeId, and 'exists' results are treated as replays.
controls.weakness: The legacy wallet path uses a random id unless transferDId is supplied (transfers.service.ts:417), so its replays are not idempotent.

controls.name: Ledger transfer payload validation
controls.description: PL, UW and GL payloads must carry eventCode, entityId and amount (plus chargeId and productCode for UW); recharges must carry stripeFee.
controls.weakness: Invalid messages are acked and dropped, not dead-lettered.

controls.name: Ledger agency-main balance query
controls.description: GET reconciliation/agencyMainBalance returns opening/closing TigerBeetle balances and the delta for a time range, used for manual tie-outs.
controls.weakness: On demand only; nothing compares it with Mongo automatically.

controls.name: Spend anomaly detection
controls.description: Each settlement compares today's debit count and amount per wallet with a baseline (modified z-score); anomalies go to transaction-anomalies and Slack with a cooldown.
controls.weakness: Flags unusual spend, not book errors; it does not reconcile balances or amounts.

controls.name: Daily Stripe vs wallet reconciliation
controls.description: Pulls one Stripe UTC day into ClickHouse and matches recharges to wallet credits by PaymentIntent: missing in wallet, missing in Stripe, amount mismatch over $0.005, and credits with no GL transfer, posted to Slack.
controls.weakness: Behind feature flags that default off, and not scheduled in production yet.

controls.name: Daily wallet vs GL ledger reconciliation
controls.description: Compares non-rebilled company wallet debits (Mongo CDC in ClickHouse) with GL TigerBeetle transfers by chargeId, lists missing and ledger-only charges, posts to Slack.
controls.weakness: Presence-only: a ledger transfer with the wrong amount for a valid chargeId would pass.

gaps.title: Agency Stripe webhook route has no signature check in code
gaps.impact: The route that delivers wallet-recharge PaymentIntents trusts the request body; whether ingress restricts who can reach it is not visible in this repo and needs confirming.
gaps.evidence: apps/stripe-consumer/src/consumer/stripe-consumer.controller.ts:35-41 takes @Body() directly; both routes are in excludedEndpoints (common/app-config/index.ts STRIPE_CONSUMER).

gaps.title: Credited amount not tied to Stripe amount received
gaps.impact: If PaymentIntent metadata.amount differs from what Stripe captured, the wallet gets the metadata value and nothing flags it in real time.
gaps.evidence: rechargeTransaction.service.ts:1669 uses Number(metadata.amount); amount_received is not compared on the agency path.

gaps.title: No balance vs sum-of-transactions check
gaps.impact: Drift between a wallet's stored balance and its transaction history (lost update, manual edit) would go undetected.
gaps.evidence: No roll-forward or balance-mismatch logic in apps/ at the pinned SHA; only per-txn prev/after balances (pendingSettlementCalculator.ts:101).

gaps.title: Stripe and ledger reconciliations not live
gaps.impact: There is no automated daily proof that Stripe money in equals wallet credits, or that wallet debits equal ledger postings.
gaps.evidence: Both are on unmerged branches; the Stripe recon has no production schedule and its flags default off.

gaps.title: Support adjustments lack maker-checker
gaps.impact: One support-portal caller can credit any amount without a second approval; temp-refund-script and bulk-update-wallets skip the credit guard.
gaps.evidence: support.controller.ts:133 (performedBy fallback), :398 (temp-refund-script, no route guard); transaction.controller.ts:39-41.

gaps.title: No reconciliation of Stripe payouts
gaps.impact: Nothing matches Stripe charges to the payouts that reach the bank, so the cash leg of order-to-cash is unproven.
gaps.evidence: No payout handling at the pinned SHA (GL payout accounts are commented out in apps/ledger/src/accounts/common.const.ts:453). The stripe-recon branch loads payouts into ClickHouse (stripeReconStore.service.ts:115) but only lists them as informational (:250).

gaps.title: Ledger postings can be skipped silently
gaps.impact: Wallet activity can be missing from TigerBeetle with only a log line: invalid payloads acked, no-glCode charges skipped, canary gate, post-commit publish failures.

gaps.title: No Stripe event.id dedupe at the consumer
gaps.impact: Every Stripe redelivery is re-published to all topics, so correctness relies on each downstream consumer's own dedupe.

gaps.title: No DB-enforced uniqueness on charge ids
gaps.impact: Duplicate prevention depends on read-then-write under Redis locks; a lock lapse could let a duplicate in.
gaps.evidence: companyWalletTransaction.schema.ts:94-105, locationWalletTransaction.schema.ts:64-69, charge.schema.ts:240-244 declare no unique chargeId/eventId index.

gaps.title: No provider cost reconciliation (Twilio, Meta/WhatsApp, Mailgun)
gaps.impact: Rebilled usage cannot be tied to provider invoices, so under-billing or margin leakage would go unnoticed; Meta/WhatsApp and Mailgun send no cost at all.
gaps.evidence: cost is optional and producer-supplied (billing.dto.ts:79); no Meta/WhatsApp or Mailgun cost fields in billing or blade-platform.

gaps.title: Ledger recon checks presence, not amount
gaps.impact: A ledger transfer with the wrong amount for a valid chargeId would pass reconciliation.
gaps.evidence: ledgerReconGateway.service.ts:69 (ledger-recon branch) sums the wallet amount for matched charges.

gaps.title: No completeness check on export to Snowflake / ClickHouse
gaps.impact: Rows dropped or lagging in the warehouse would skew reporting and the ClickHouse-based reconciliations unnoticed.
gaps.evidence: No row-count or amount tie-out to Mongo found in apps/; the Snowflake loader lives outside the workspace.

gaps.title: Free allowance and hard caps can be overshot
gaps.impact: Concurrent usage can exceed a hard limit or free allowance because the limit is not re-checked at reserve time.

gaps.title: Funds check allows charges beyond the balance
gaps.impact: Any single charge can push a wallet negative, creating receivables that rely on a later auto-recharge.

gaps.title: billevent/failure is accepted on a parked charge
gaps.impact: If a caller releases a hold after Billing 5xx parked the charge, the retry sweep can still bill it later while the usage counter has already been released. Only caller discipline (never fail after BILL_RETRY_PENDING) prevents the mismatch.
gaps.evidence: GoHighLevel/platform-core wallet-sdk README, "Known gaps and roadmap"; Gatekeeper follow-up. On master Gatekeeper does not emit BILL_RETRY_PENDING at all (only on fix/gatekeeper-error-contract), so callers can't tell a parked charge apart.

gaps.title: Retried validate calls can leave duplicate holds
gaps.impact: Validate calls take no caller idempotency key. A retry after a timeout holds usage a second time, and the extra hold is only cleared at the billing window rollover, which can deny later usage early.
gaps.evidence: GoHighLevel/platform-core wallet-sdk README, "Known gaps and roadmap"; the SDK refuses to retry validate calls on TIMEOUT/NETWORK for this reason.

gaps.title: Billing 5xx before the event record exists is not parked
gaps.impact: The charge may never be retried by the sweep, and the caller gets Billing's raw error instead of BILL_RETRY_PENDING, so it cannot tell whether to release or wait.
gaps.evidence: GoHighLevel/platform-core wallet-sdk README, "Known gaps and roadmap"; Gatekeeper follow-up.

gaps.title: SDK error codes and /sdk-config depend on an unmerged Gatekeeper PR
gaps.impact: wallet-sdk 0.3.0 expects BILL_RETRY_PENDING, REBILLING_DISABLED and GET /sdk-config, which exist only on ghl-revex-backend#17529 (open). Against master those fall back to HTTP-status mapping and built-in defaults, and per-caller timeouts can't be changed.
gaps.evidence: git grep on ghl-revex-backend master finds no sdk-config route and no BILL_RETRY_PENDING/REBILLING_DISABLED; both are on fix/gatekeeper-error-contract@4a9d074.

gaps.title: Istio retry policy for Gatekeeper not confirmed
gaps.impact: Istio's default policy may already retry 503s on POSTs, which would repeat validate calls and create duplicate holds. SDK-level retries are on hold until this is known.
gaps.evidence: GoHighLevel/platform-core wallet-sdk README, "Known gaps and roadmap"; "Automatic retries: On hold".
